chunks: Whatever is in it from ‘Īsā ibn Yūnus, I have narrated it from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn Ziyād ibn Ja‘far al-Hamdānī—may Allah be pleased with him—from ‘Alī ibn Ibrāhīm, from his father, from Muḥammad ibn Sinān, from Ḥammād ibn ‘Uthmān, from ‘Īsā ibn Yūnus.

key_terms.أَبِيهِ: his father; a link in the chain referring to the preceding narrator’s father
key_terms.الْهَمْدَانِيِّ: al-Hamdānī; a nisbah identifying the narrator’s attribution
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; indicates the author’s act of narration
key_terms.عَنْ: from; the transmission marker used throughout the sanad/isnad

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to ‘Īsā ibn Yūnus in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage gives the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits narrations from ‘Īsā ibn Yūnus. It serves as a chain clarification in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh, documenting the line of transmission rather than conveying a legal or theological matn.
